Command: Cleave to God and walk in His ways
Summary: Deuteronomy 10:20 commands cleaving to God: 'thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave.' Cleaving is clinging loyalty, the opposite of drifting to other gods.
Commandment: Cleave to God, and walk in his ways.
Application: Fear belongs with serving and cleaving to the God who brought Israel out of Egypt and keeps covenant (Deuteronomy 10:20-22). Cleaving is daily, not occasional: service and loyalty held together.
Purpose: Scripture's stated context: fear belongs with serving and cleaving to the God who brought Israel out of Egypt and keeps covenant (Deuteronomy 10:20-22).
